hypothesis_overrides.NONE: The speech is small talk, thinking aloud or noise.

abstention_rule.description: Chosen on the dev split only, fixed before test and test2 are scored: abstain (no label) when the top softmax score is below TAU, where TAU is the smallest value on a 0.01 grid for which the accuracy of the ANSWERED dev rows (actual-status rows, 20-way) is at least 0.80, the same bar as the credit gate's credited precision (MIN_PRECISION). Abstention is reported separately from the label NONE.
